limitations: No medical diagnosis is inferred from selection patterns.
Suspension rules are watch/review-only until the current SFA protocol is sourced.
No contract-expiry, free-agent, wage or fee data is held.
Provider ratings are opaque and league-relative.
Provider xG is one provider's model, not fitba fxG; the two are never blended.
Possession is provider-reported and is not used in the matchday style lean.
League ranks compare Premiership teams only; no cross-league comparison is made.
A contradicted team-news claim is available by default, not a verified fit; its evidence stays in the review block.
A ledger older than the latest official news is flagged for review.
coverage.qualification: Scotland has four UEFA places for 2027/28: the champions enter the Champions League second qualifying round, the Scottish Cup winner enters the Europa League first qualifying round, and 2nd and 3rd enter the Conference League second qualifying round. 4th only qualifies if the Scottish Cup winner is already in the top three. The League Cup carries no European place. Subject to the final UEFA access list and cup outcomes.
